notes.title: Welcome to the REV UP Community Hub 🏁🚨
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,
[/p][p]We’re [b]Chonky Frog Studio[/b], a small indie team working on [b]REV UP[/b], a Racers VS. Cops multiplayer racing game that blends speed, stealth, and tactics.[/p][p][/p][p]This is our first post here, so we just wanted to say hi and thank you for checking out the game. We’ll be using this space to share updates, behind-the-scenes bits, and answer any questions you might have.[/p][p][/p][p]The game is still in early development, but there’s already some stuff we’re excited to share. If you’ve already added REV UP to your [b]wishlist[/b], thank you so much. It really means a lot![/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to leave a comment, ask anything, or just say hi. You can also follow us on [url="https://x.com/Chonky_Frog"]Twitter/ X[/url] and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/chonkyfrogstudio.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] if you want to see more REV UP content and dev updates.[/p][p][/p][p]More soon!
[/p][p]The REV UP team[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171995/639d97cc826c226cbf9e023d205202e8e4bd1549.png"][/img][/p]
